text.title: FreshDrop express slots, test 1–14 September 2026
text.hypothesis: If buyers see 2-hour slots on the first screen, they book one in under a minute, because the picker stops being hidden
text.question: Will 8 of 10 buyers find and pick a slot without help in under 60 seconds?
text.scope: Home screen, slot picker, cart and checkout for 3 scenarios; payment is only drawn
text.participants: 8 Moscow buyers who ordered in the last 30 days, recruited by SMS
text.tasks: Order milk and bread for tomorrow evening, choose a slot, pay
text.observe: Where they hesitate on the picker, which button they tap first, what they expect
text.findings: 7 of 8 booked a slot, median time 52 s; 3 missed the picker on the first screen
text.next: Move 2-hour slots to the first screen; retest with 6 buyers on 20 September
